title: SearchOutput
description: The JSON document produced by the search command after collection starts.

status.description: Whether collection finished within the requested conditions and limit.

incomplete_reason.description: Why collection stopped early. Present only when status is incomplete.

retrieved_at.description: UTC time at which this collection run started.

post_count.description: Number of posts examined, before resource and source deduplication.

resource_count.description: Number of distinct normalized resources; equals the length of resources.

resources.description: Distinct external resources. Always an array, including for zero results.

query.description: The X search expression before the language operator is added.

language.description: Optional X language code; omitted when not specified.

start_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 lower time bound; omitted when not specified.

end_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 upper time bound; omitted when not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to examine.

sources.description: Deduplicated source posts for this resource.

post_url.description: Canonical x.com URL for the source post.

text.description: Post or note-post text returned by X.

created_at.description: Upstream created_at value; an empty string is used when X omits it.

short_url.description: Original shortened URL from the post; an empty string is allowed when X omits it.
